test_title: PYST 5: SSC CGL - Reasoning (Held On : 12 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven friends, Subhi, Prince, Ketan, Vishal, Mahima, Krish and Naitik, are sitting around a circular table with their backs towards the centre. Subhi is sitting to the immediate right of Prince. Naitik and Krish are not sitting to the immediate left or right of Vishal. Vishal is sitting third to the left of Prince. Mahima is sitting to the immediate right of Vishal. Who is sitting third to the right of Prince?
solution:
Given:

Seven friends sitting around a circular table with their backs towards the centre this means they are facing outside the centre: Subhi, Prince, Ketan, Vishal, Mahima, Krish and Naitik,

1) Subhi is sitting to the immediate right of Prince.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/81faf7897aef5cf9b738c1d7e9b600f835fe416173e61e0a9b47a3e2336d8e4f.png] 

2) Vishal is sitting third to the left of Prince.
